correctness.rationale: Narasimhan–Seshadri equates stability of unitary-associated symmetric powers with irreducibility; Clebsch–Gordan decomposes End(Sym^k V) into all Sym^{2j}V for j<=k. Thus first failure is half first invariant binary-form degree. Proper compact irreducible SU(2) subgroup classification leaves normalizer/dihedral (first failure <=2), tetrahedral (3), octahedral (4), icosahedral (6), while SU2 never fails. Classical binary-group invariant presentations yield the precise E7/E8 graded hypersurface rings after dividing form degrees by 2. Existence follows from two-generator finite group quotients of the genus-two surface group.
